description: This file defines the GDPR model class for the OpenCart admin module, providing database operations related to GDPR records such as editing status, deletion, retrieval, and filtering of GDPR data.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: A model class for managing GDPR records in the database, including CRUD operations and queries with filtering options.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdpr
methods.description: Deletes a GDPR record from the database using its gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdprsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all GDPR records associated with a specific store identified by store_id.

methods.name: getGdprs
methods.description: Retrieves multiple GDPR records based on optional filter criteria.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Fetches a single GDPR record by its gdpr_id.

methods.name: getTotalGdprs
methods.description: Counts total GDPR records matching optional filter criteria.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR records with status '2' and date_added less than or equal to a limit date.
